sloka: यथा सेना समग्रा मे यूथपालाः च सर्वशः ।समागच्छन्ति असंगेन सेनाग्राणि तथा कुरु ॥४-२९-३०॥
transliteration: yathā senā samagrā me yūthapālāḥ ca sarvaśaḥ ।samāgacchanti asaṁgena senāgrāṇi tathā kuru ॥4-29-30॥

translations.english: He sent word to the ever diligent Nila, his favourite, to collect all cadres of army of the monkeys from all directions.
